notes.title: New Update 1.1!!
notes.content: [h3]This update includes new languages (Spanish 🇪🇸, Portuguese 🇵🇹, Russian 🇷🇺, and Romanian 🇷🇴) and some audio improvements[/h3]

notes.title: New update coming soon
notes.content:
I am pleased to announce that soon Rush The Towers will be available in multiple languages, allowing more users around the world to enjoy it. Additionally, there will be updates and progress on new maps, characters, abilities, and more game lore content coming soon...
